decision: Do not implement either experimental registration policy in the native/default/frontend path. Rematched trials regress34 originally converged histories to no_descent; held-ID trials exchange six converged/limited histories in each direction and require more accepted steps. Lower residual score alone is not evidence of better physical alignment.
native_scope: Add only an independent explicit unit-weight gicp_transported_linearization API. Return the unchanged frozen factor fields plus metric_gradient_rotation, objective_gradient and objective_right_hand_side. Keep normal_matrix/right_hand_side as the frozen definitions; the normal matrix is not claimed to be the exact transported Hessian. No registration params, solver, trial, convergence, cycle guard or frontend behavior changes.
core_contract: gicp_transported::linearize(pairs,pose,center,parallel) first calls unchanged gicp::linearize for all original validation/results. Then require every external weight exactly1 in input order. Compute C^-1r with Cholesky backsubstitution, canonical source-shape transport and e cross(S e) per row. Validate finite contributions and ordered accumulation. Parallel row work must retain all serial output/error bits; original factor and registration paths never call it implicitly.
python_contract: gicp_transported_linearization(source,target,source_shapes,target_shapes,pose,center_world,*,parallel=False).
